report.root_cause: At 08:13:49 a burst of commands sent over RCON summoned 384 unnamed pigs (temporarily tagged 'mcsre_f') near spawn, around (-6,-60,-15). The pigs were then made to summon item entities (sticks, oak logs and others), about 1536 in total. Entities went from 24 to about 1944. It was a one-time burst, not an ongoing spawner, and it did not come back during the shift.
report.actions: 1) Saw entities jump from 24 to 1944 (1536 items, 385 pigs) and declared the incident. 2) Used the logs to trace it to the RCON summon burst, then confirmed the spawning had stopped. 3) Found the one legitimate pig: it is the only pig with a custom name ('Wilbur'). The other 384 were unnamed and spawned by command. Bessie the cow and Dolly the sheep are also named and were not involved. 4) Ran 'kill @e[type=pig,name=Pig]', which removed 384 entities and left Wilbur. 5) Ran 'kill @e[type=item,x=-6,y=-60,z=-15,distance=..80]', which removed 1652 items: the flood items plus the porkchops the killed pigs dropped. There were no item entities before the flood. 6) Ran a kill for XP orbs; none were found. 7) Watched for about 80 s afterwards: entities stayed at the 24 baseline, TPS 20, MSPT about 0.5. No restart, no file changes, no bans.
report.residual_risk: The flood came from commands sent over RCON, so anyone with RCON access could do it again. Review who has RCON access and the RCON password. Any items players dropped within 80 blocks of (-6,-60,-15) during the flood would have been removed with the cleanup, but there were no items on the ground before it.
